notes: One Claude switch connects or disconnects Code and Desktop together, while preserving connections to other Kits.
Installed desktop tools, including Codex, are recognised before they create their first profile folder. You can complete setup with any one supported surface.
The Lantern refreshes memories while you browse and when you return.
Nightly memory maintenance recovers more reliably after interruptions and can continue when a slow step times out.
Scheduled backups wait for active imports and use a consistent snapshot, so new memories cannot cause misleading restore-check failures.
Routine label formatting is tidied automatically. Names that need more context stay separate, without asking you to manage technical merges.
Logs and support diagnostics use limited storage, and older settings snapshots are cleaned up conservatively.
